async function obtainSixRawCopper(bot) {
    // The function checks if the player already possesses at least six raw copper items. If not, it attempts to find and equip either a stone or wooden pickaxe. It first searches for nearby copper ore blocks to mine up to the required amount. If none are found nearby, it explores the area until copper ore is located. Finally, it equips a pickaxe again and mines the remaining necessary copper ore to ensure six raw copper items are obtained.
}
